name: 🍆 Chicken & Eggplant Parm
what: Crispy breaded chicken and eggplant, baked with sauce and melted mozzarella.

core.name: Eggs + panko
core.out: crushed crackers or plain bread crumbs

extras: parmesan, flour, oregano, garlic powder, pasta to serve

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 425°F. Oil two foil-lined pans.
Slice the eggplant into ½-inch rounds and salt them. Slice thick chicken in half the long way.
Three plates: flour, beaten egg, panko + parmesan. Dip each piece in all three. Onto the pans, spray with oil.
Sauce and cheese on each piece; bake until bubbly.

key: Salt the eggplant and pat it dry before breading so it bakes crisp.
done: Golden and crispy, cheese bubbling, chicken 165°F inside.
plan_b: Skip the breading: bake the chicken plain, then sauce and cheese on top.
